intro: The rest of the work, kept short: what the problem was and what was actually done.

items.name: 94K-cell test chip
items.body: Floorplan cleanup, timing closure, power-integrity analysis and physical verification on a memory-heavy test chip. Debugged mem2out, in2out, in2mem and reg2reg paths; traced violations back to virtual-clock constraints and returned constraint fixes to the owners; closed large memory-interface hold violations; analysed IR-drop around memory regions and improved the power network and RLRP; fixed DRC and FAB_DRC and ran LVS.

items.name: GPU blocks — preCTS and CTS
items.body: Ran and analysed preCTS and CTS on GPU blocks: cluster-mode CTS analysis, skew-group analysis, long clock-latency debugging and module-distribution work. Optimized congestion and density, adjusted placement for timing, and debugged timing differences between Innovus and ICC2 on the same data.

items.name: Metal ECO and signoff
items.body: Implemented functional, timing and metal-only ECOs, including netlist handling for metal-layer changes. Re-ran timing, DRC, LVS and FPPG after each ECO, and ran full-flatten top-level FESD and LVL checks before signoff.

items.name: Chip-top physical verification
items.body: Chip-top PV support: base-layer and metal-layer DRC debugging, determining whether a violation originated in the block or at top level, fixing chip-top DRC, and scripting the debug loop so large violation sets could be triaged quickly.
